caption: A jackhammer starts up on a street, and the coffee in cups on a café terrace table shows rings of tiny ripples.

sa.check: A café terrace table with cups of coffee on it.
A jackhammer on the street starts up: its bit begins to pound.
The coffee surfaces show rings of ripples.
The ripples are fine rings, not sloshing waves.
The jackhammer starts first and the ripples follow.

pc.expect: Ripples appear while the hammer pounds and vanish when it pauses.
pc.fail: The hammer pounds and the coffee stays glassy; or the coffee ripples while the hammer is lifted and still; or the ripples begin before the hammer starts.

pc.expect: The ripples are a fine trembling of the surface in place; the coffee stays level in its cup.
pc.fail: The coffee sloshes up one side of the cup as if pushed; or spills over with the cup standing still; or swirls round as if stirred; or a single ring spreads outward from one point with nothing dropped in.

pc.expect: The coffee stays in the cups with a level surface and the cups stay on the table.
pc.fail: Coffee rises out of a cup; or the surface tilts and stays tilted; or a cup lifts off the table.

pc.expect: The cups and table stay rigid and the coffee stays a liquid.
pc.fail: The cups wobble like rubber; or the table top ripples like water; or the coffee surface cracks like a skin.

pc.expect: The cups keep their count; one hammer; nothing passes through the table or the pavement.
pc.fail: Cups appear or vanish; or a cup sinks into the table; or the hammer bit passes through the pavement without breaking it; or the coffee vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cups' patterns, the coffee's colour and the chairs stay the same.
pc.fail: Cup patterns change; or the coffee changes colour; or the chairs change shape.

note: The worker holding the jackhammer is a trigger and is not judged.
